text:
Maya: Heads up — planning to roll the routing/v2 changes tonight at 22:00 UTC. This is a non-urgent release but touches request routing + cache keys. Can we confirm observability and smoke plan?

Maya: Who's owning the deploy? Expected canary 10% for 10m, then 50% for 10m, then full. Rollback if error-rate > 1% or p95 latency > 2x baseline.

Sam: I can run the deploy and watch the first canary. I'll trigger from the release pipeline unless someone objects. :thumbsup:

Liam: I'll add a temporary trace tag for this release: `release:routing-v2` so traces are filterable. Also adding a KV-cache metric tag so we can see cache hit skew.

Ingrid: SRE checklist: schedule a 10m canary window, enable replay sampling for traces for that window, and create an on-call pager if the error alert fires. Suggest lowering the alert threshold during rollout to make it noisy: set error-rate alert from 2% -> 1% for the next 30m.

Maya: Good call. Sam — can you update the alert thresholds before the canary?

Sam: Yep. I'll push a transient alert override in Grafana.

Ben: I'll update the runbook and add a dashboard link. Which panels do we want visible in the smoke-check view?

Liam: Minimal smoke view: 1) request rate, 2) error rate (5xx/%), 3) p50/p95 token latency, 4) cache hit ratio, 5) trace waterfall for `request_router`. Also a quick log tail for `router:WARN` and `router:ERROR`.

Maya: QA smoke steps (quick):
1) hit healthcheck endpoint for a few services
2) run a small sample of canned prompts to ensure routing goes to correct model pools
3) run batching stress with low qps to validate latency

Maya: Example curl for step 2:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"smoke test routing v2","model":"test-route-1"}'
```

qa-bot: Scheduled: smoke tests queued to run at 22:05 UTC (10 requests across 3 routes). Results will post here.

Ingrid: For alerts, propose two short-lived overrides:
- `routing_v2_error_rate` => fire at 1% for 30m (instead of 2%)
- `latency_p95_multiplier` => fire when p95 > 1.8x baseline for 30m
I'll add the policies and link them here.

Sam: Added the alert override and annotated it in the pipeline. I also added a grafana snapshot to the release notes: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/smoke-view?orgId=1 :eyes:

Maya: Great. Who's monitoring traces during canary? Liam + Ingrid?

Liam: I'll drive traces and filter on `release:routing-v2`. Will monitor any hotspots in `request_router` span and check KV cache usage per shard.

Ingrid: I'll watch the error rate and latency, and will escalate if alerts trigger. If we see steady errors at canary -> rollback. Sam, be ready to flip the pipeline rollback.

Sam: Standby for rollback — I can revert the commit and promote previous image in ~3m.

Ben: Runbook updated: added checklist, rollback steps, grafana link, smoke curl snippet, and contact list. Will ping #oncall when we start.

Maya: One last thing: can someone add a short-lived metric to identify canary traffic in logs? `X-Canary: routing-v2` header would do it. That way log-based queries are trivial.

Liam: I'll add the header in the router config and include it in request logs for the canary flag. Deploy config PR incoming (small change).

deploy-bot: [pipeline] Release pipeline scheduled by Sam to start at 22:00 UTC. Build sha: cf2a9e1. Canary policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

qa-bot: Smoke tests finished: 10/10 success. Posting results to the PR.

Maya: Nice. Start time is still on for 22:00. Sam — mark when you flip canary.

Sam: Canary at 22:01 UTC. Monitoring now. :eyes:

Liam: Traces look clean so far. No new hotspots. Cache hit ratio steady.

Ingrid: No pager so far. Error-rate at 0.15% during canary. Latency p95 at 1.05x baseline. Holding to 50% step.

Sam: Promoted to 50% at 22:12.

Maya: Thanks everyone. If anything spikes, let's follow the rollback runbook. Otherwise I'll post completion when full rollout finishes. :party_parrot:

deploy-bot: [pipeline] Promoted to 100% at 22:21 UTC. Successful rollout.

Maya: Rollout complete. Closing this thread — runbook and dashboard preserved in the release notes.

Ben: Follow-up action: make the smoke-view dashboard a one-click from the release pipeline. Filed: ENG-1423.

Sam: Thanks all. Good job.

Ingrid: Nice and smooth. :tada:
